Picton Mahoney Asset Management increased its stake in Nvidia Corp (NVDA) by 103.92% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Picton Mahoney Asset Management bought 37,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 44.72% with the market. The institutional investor held 72,800 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $20.46M, up from 35,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Picton Mahoney Asset Management who had been investing in Nvidia Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.29B market cap company. The stock increased 0.68% or $0.98 during the last trading session, reaching $144.73. About 15.63M shares traded. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has declined 20.90% since February 2, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.90% the S&P500.
Picton Mahoney Asset Management, which manages about $1.42 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Micron Technology Inc (NASDAQ:MU) by 115,984 shares to 165,116 shares, valued at $7.47 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Matador Res Co (NYSE:MTDR) by 158,813 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 340,707 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
